notes: Since September 2026, MVG's new online ticketshop lets customers purchase day tickets and save them directly to Apple Wallet without needing the MVGO app or an account. Subscription tickets (D-Ticket, 365-Euro-Ticket, MVV Abo) still require monthly manual re-add.
